On 20 February 1962 John Glenn became the first American to orbit the Earth, in the Mercury capsule Friendship 7. After splashdown in the Atlantic he was flown to Grand Turk for his debriefing.

The United States had a missile tracking station on Grand Turk, part of the range down from Cape Canaveral in Florida. That is why the astronaut first set foot on land in the Turks and Caicos.

The flight came during the space race of the Cold War, less than a year after Yuri Gagarin. A copy of the capsule stands at the airport on Grand Turk.
